def transform(g):
    ts=[tinfo(c) for c in comps(g)]
    ups=sorted([t for t in ts if t['orient']=='u'], key=lambda t:(t['top'],t['left']))
    dws=sorted([t for t in ts if t['orient']=='d'], key=lambda t:(t['top'],t['left']))
    def pair(lst):
        ps=[(lst[i],lst[i+1]) for i in range(0,len(lst)-1,2)]
        lone=lst[-1] if len(lst)%2 else None
        return ps,lone
    up_p,up_l=pair(ups); dw_p,dw_l=pair(dws)
    out=[[0]*6 for _ in range(3)]
    def place(upper,lower):
        ctr=(lower['left']+upper['right'])/2
        col=3*(lower['orient']=='d')+2*(ctr>=6)
        out[0][col]={'u':3,'d':1}[upper['orient']]
        out[2][col]={'u':3,'d':1}[lower['orient']]
    for p in up_p+dw_p: place(*p)
    for lone in (up_l, dw_l):
        if lone:
            ctr=(lone['left']+lone['right'])/2
            out[0][3*(lone['orient']=='d')+2*(ctr>=6)]={'u':3,'d':1}[lone['orient']]
    return out
